checklist.title: 1. Review Required Information & AI Validation Checks
checklist.description: Audit and verify all submitted client information and uploads against statutory compliance standards (KYC/FICA certification, CIPC director confirmation, SARS Tax Compliance Status). Mark items as approved or rejected with specific comments before progressing.
checklist.aiInstructions: Perform automated OCR & validation checks on all client uploads and text inputs. Verify that mobile numbers (10 digits starting with 0), email addresses, 13-digit SA ID numbers, and CIPC enterprise numbers match statutory formats. Check that certifications are valid (< 3 months). Mark approved/rejected in Firestore and queue drafts.

checklist.title: 2. Prepare Draft Documents from Templates
checklist.description: Generate pre-filled statutory drafts, resolutions, and application forms from verified client information and attach for consultant review.
checklist.aiInstructions: Only trigger document generation once all client KYC/information items are marked approved. Use My Accountant Navy & Gold templates, strict 1-page constraints, and official practice credentials (Kevin Freese CBAP SA #3561).

checklist.title: 3. Statutory Lodgement & Service Execution
checklist.description: Execute compliance filings, calculations, or statutory registrations with authorities (e.g. CIPC, NCR, SARS, Labour).
checklist.aiInstructions: Compile final verified application dossier, ensure all mandated director signatures are captured, and submit via regulatory gateway or official channel. Log submission reference numbers.

checklist.title: 4. Final Review & Document Dispatch
checklist.description: Quality audit results, generate output certificates/reports, and post note with downloadable files in Communication History.
checklist.aiInstructions: Post deliverables, confirmation letters, and client updates exclusively through Order Communication History. Never send direct external emails without portal audit trail.
